name: sidebar-15
title: Sidebar 15
description: A left and a right sidebar: the notes pad hangs from the left and folds away, the calendar pad is taped in on the right and stays (from the lg breakpoint up), the page is a sheet between them. Mirrors shadcn's sidebar-15. Looks right on the desk and on plain paper.

files.content:
import * as React from "react"

import { appTeams, notesFavorites, notesNav, notesSecondary, notesWorkspaces } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-data"
import { NavSecondary } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-nav-app"
import { NavFavorites, NavLinks, NavWorkspaces } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-nav-notes"
import { TeamSwitcher } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-shared/sidebar-team-switcher"
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarHeader, SidebarRail } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

export function SidebarLeft({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Sidebar>) {
  return (
    <Sidebar role="navigation" aria-label="Notes" {...props}>
      <SidebarHeader>
        <TeamSwitcher teams={appTeams} compact />
        <NavLinks items={notesNav} />
      </SidebarHeader>
      <SidebarContent>
        <NavFavorites favorites={notesFavorites} />
        <NavWorkspaces workspaces={notesWorkspaces} />
        <NavSecondary items={notesSecondary} className="mt-auto" />
      </SidebarContent>
      <SidebarRail />
    </Sidebar>
  )
}
